title: My phone rings a doorbell through my ESP32

lines.text: I tap my phone, and a doorbell rings on my desk.
No app. No router. No internet.
The ESP32 opens its own little Wi-Fi, like a phone hotspot.
My phone joins it, and opens the board's own web page.
Every button is a link. Tap ring, the link flies through the air...
...and the board plays two notes on the buzzer, ding dong.
The color buttons change the light, and the little screen counts every command.
No new parts: the color light, a screen and a buzzer.
Want to build things like this? Follow the channel, and tell me what you'd control with your phone.
